certificateStatusEntry.title: Certificate Record on the Certificate Registry
certificateStatusEntry.description: Type extension for credentialStatus in the Slovak Professional License Registry. Its PlrLedgerStatusEntry names the certificate registry contract (chain and address) that keeps the certificate's record. A verifier computes the record's key from the issuer's DID and the credential's id, so the entry carries no key. VCDM 1.1; extends the EBSI Verifiable Attestation.

credentialStatus.description: One entry must be the PlrLedgerStatusEntry; other status entries may sit beside it.
